issue.title: bob-ledger-tools catalog data services spawn bob areas/projects/notebooks/albums list on every file-open and active-leaf-change

task_type_fields.impact:
Every Obsidian note switch costs 4-5 bob subprocesses on every desktop host. That adds
load during ordinary editing, and late results can repaint the next note mid-open,
which competes with the cabinets Reading paint budget. This behavior predates cabinets
(the inline painters already subscribed permanently), so it is not cabinets-caused.
task_type_fields.repro:
In bob-plugins `plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src`, every catalog data service registers
`file-open` and `active-leaf-change` workspace listeners that schedule a forced
report refresh whenever the service has any subscriber:
`241ag-plugin-areas-data-service.js:328` (`areasScheduleRevalidate` → `apiAreasReport({ force: true })`),
`241ab-plugin-projects-data-service.js:710`, `241a-plugin-notebook-data.js:855`,
`241m-plugin-album-data-service.js:633`, and `241j-plugin-bank-data.js:589-590`.
The inline catalog painters (`241aj`, `241ae`, `241d`, `241q`, `241t`) subscribe for
the plugin's whole lifetime, so the services always have subscribers. Since cabinets
went live (bob-plugins 64268af9), `241al` subscribes too.

Result: every note switch spawns `bob areas list`, `bob projects list`,
`bob notebooks list`, `bob albums list`, and bank config/report (4-5 bob processes)
after a 300 ms debounce, even when no visible note shows any catalog. The results can
also land inside a later open and repaint it.

Repro: in a scratch vault with a bob shim that logs its argv, switch between plain
notes that have no catalogs. Each switch logs one round of list/report invocations.
bob-cli-qq.10.1 observed it while profiling the cabinets Reading paint
(file:explicit:99309d341ce63ec6d8668bdf has the mark timelines).

Proposed remediation (needs a decision): revalidate on vault `modify`/`create`/`delete`
events for catalog-relevant files, or only while a visible surface needs the report.
Drop the unconditional workspace-event revalidation.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-qq.10.1 (note #13, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-qq.10 land agent: catalog data services spawn bob list commands on every note switch, which predates cabinets and is outside that epic's scope.
